beta.changelog: * New: Noxpress Core 1.2.0 adds Install all, Update all and Uninstall all to the Noxpress hub. Each opens a checklist to confirm and then works one plugin at a time through WordPress's own installer, with the usual sha256 and signature check. Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

* New: Noxpress Core 1.2.0 adds Install all, Update all and Uninstall all to the Noxpress hub. Each opens a checklist to confirm and then works one plugin at a time through WordPress's own installer, with the usual sha256 and signature check. Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

* New: module «Instagram» (source, off by default). New posts of your Instagram account (Business or Creator) through the Instagram API with Instagram Login and a token from your own Meta app, read every 30 minutes (15–120). Photos and albums by default; videos and Reels with a switch. Hashtags at the end of the caption are removed by default. A caption too long for a picture post is cut at a word so the picture and the link stay. The image is asked for again just before posting, since Instagram image links expire. The token is sealed and renewed every month; the admin warns 7 days before it expires.
* New: ability broadcast/queue-reject (drops a waiting item), for the Site Bridge app.
* Changed: the Viber connection no longer shows «0 subscribers» when Viber does not report the number.

* New: Noxpress Core 1.2.0 adds Install all, Update all and Uninstall all to the Noxpress hub. Each opens a checklist to confirm and then works one plugin at a time through WordPress's own installer, with the usual sha256 and signature check. Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

* Optional backup encryption (beta), off by default: AES-256 (WinZip AE-2), readable by 7-Zip, WinZip and macOS, with a password stored sealed or set in wp-config.php (`NM_BACKUP_PASSWORD`), and a password generator.
* Encrypted backups in the analysis, the restore, the installer and WP-CLI (`--password`); uploaded encrypted backups register without the password.
* `wp data-migrator list` shows whether a backup is encrypted.

* First release (beta): page cache with a drop-in and test mode, smart purging, background preload from the sitemap, CSS / JS minify, lazy load for images, iframes and backgrounds, click-to-play YouTube, image dimensions, hover preload, import from WP Rocket, database cleanup, and seven abilities for Site Bridge.

* New: Access → "No window for abilities that only add something that waits" (off by default). With level write or above, the abilities on that list run through `ability_run` while the write window is closed, so a daily routine can prepare posts without anyone opening the window. The list has one ability: `broadcast/queue-add` (Broadcast 1.0.0), whose posts wait for «Published» on the site. The write scope is still needed, and every call is in the history as before.
